description: This Java source file defines the SlidingFragments activity class, which manages a UI with two Fragments (ImageFragment and TextFragment), performing animated transitions between them, including scaling, rotating, and overlay effects using ObjectAnimator and AnimatorSet.

classes.name: SlidingFragments
classes.description: Main activity managing fragment animations and transitions in the demo app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, retrieves and sets up fragments, and assigns click listeners.

methods.name: switchFragments
methods.description: Toggles between showing and hiding the text fragment with animation, managing fragment transactions.

methods.name: slideBack
methods.description: Animates the image fragment into the background with scaling and rotation, and fades in a dark overlay.

methods.name: slideForward
methods.description: Animates the image fragment into the foreground, reversing previous transformations, and removes overlay.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback indicating animation completion, resets the animating state.
